summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 26, 2026, attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return required under Hong Kong Exchange Listing Rules. The disclosure reports a routine repurchase of 216,100 A ordinary shares on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong at HKD 19.6623 per share, representing 0.0229% of existing issued shares. The shares were held as treasury shares, increasing total treasury shares to 29,952,356. This is a standard capital management activity, not a special situation event. The filing confirms board authorization and compliance with all applicable rules. No risk-arb angle; this is a non-event for special-situations analysis.
